summary: In the elevator shaft, Neo ratchets a clamp onto the elevator cable and both clamps lock on. He looks up the long, dark throat of the building and takes a deep breath, then says, 'There is no spoon.' He whips out his gun and presses it to the cable, lower than where they attached themselves, and fires. The cable snaps, the counter-weights plummet, and the elevator falls away beneath them, yanking Trinity and Neo up through the shaft as they sear to the top amid the sound of whistling metal.
